text: In CCHM, the cofibration system consists of propositions built from:
choices: face lattice formulas built from interval variables (e.g. i=0, j=1, i=j) using ∧ and ∨
explanation: The face lattice in CCHM: formulas φ ::= i=0 | i=1 | i=j | φ∧ψ | φ∨ψ | ⊥ | ⊤. These specify the 'faces' on which partial elements are defined.
